entities.title: Culture-sensitive calls are build errors
entities.summary: The analyzer rules for implicit culture and string comparison (CA1304, CA1305, CA1307, CA1309, CA1310, CA1311) are errors in the library's .editorconfig, and the project treats warnings as errors.
entities.context: UTV forbids hidden environment: output must not depend on the host's locale.
entities.decision: Every number and string is formatted and compared with CultureInfo.InvariantCulture or an ordinal comparison; the compiler refuses code that does not say so. A test also scans the source for clock, host-zone and culture reads, and another runs operations under an odd culture.
entities.rationale: The .editorconfig comment: culture and comparison must always be explicit; the library never depends on the host locale.

entities.title: The structural schema is linked, not copied
entities.summary: Utv.csproj embeds schema/utv-1.0.schema.json from the repository root as resource Utv.utv-1.0.schema.json.
entities.context: The library validates against the repository's structural schema, and libraries must read the shared material in place.
entities.decision: An EmbeddedResource item links the repository file into the assembly at build time. SchemaTests checks that the embedded text equals the repository file.
entities.rationale: The project file's comment: the structural schema is linked from the repository root, never copied. One file, so the library cannot drift from the schema.

entities.title: parseIso and formatIso where the contract is silent
entities.summary: Valid ISO 8601 forms the everyday contract does not mention are unsupported, not invalid; and a value whose offset has no ±hh:mm form is not formatted.
entities.context: docs/everyday-api.md lists what parseIso handles and what is unsupported, but not every valid ISO 8601 form.
entities.decision: A decimal comma, a year on its own, a time with T or an offset, and basic-format offsets give unsupported (unsupported-form); more than nine fraction digits gives unsupported (implementation-limit). An offsetAssertion that is not a whole number of minutes cannot be formatted, so formatIso gives unsupported. Every invalid check comes before every unsupported one, so T25:00 stays invalid.
entities.rationale: They are valid ISO 8601, which the library does not handle: unsupported is the truthful answer, and invalid is kept for text that is wrong.

entities.title: [0-9] and \z in every pattern
entities.summary: The library's regular expressions use [0-9] rather than \d and \z rather than $.
entities.context: In .NET, \d matches any Unicode digit and $ also matches before a final newline.
entities.decision: Iso's patterns and UtvValidator's version pattern use [0-9] and \A…\z; the schema interpreter rewrites $ in schema patterns to \z.
entities.rationale: The code comments: so that only ASCII digits are read, and utv/1.0 followed by a newline is not a well-formed identifier.

entities.title: Results report an empty manifest
entities.summary: UtvResult.ToJson always writes an empty manifest, no assumptions and a lossless loss report.
entities.context: utv-result/1.0 results carry a manifest of the rules used, assumptions and a loss report.
entities.decision: The C# results do not track them. The class's remarks say why this is acceptable for now: the everyday operations are exact, and the rules a resolve or toZone used are the ZoneRules the caller passed in.
entities.rationale: As stated in UtvResult's remarks. The cost is recorded as debt in this folder's backlog (manifest-in-results).
